provenanceNote: The id still describes the input, so it stands; only the outcome moved. The 1800 floor rejects the year 0012. This fixture keeps its original coverage precisely because it fails: had the year been remapped to 1912 -- the Date.UTC trap in docs/open-threads.md §3.5, which JavaScript would do and PHP would not -- it would clear the floor and parse. Reaching implausible-birth-date proves no remapping occurred. Century "00" has never been issued by Skatteverket, so no bearer can exist.

A Region Stockholm-shaped reservnummer. docs/open-threads.md 1.3 decided interim numbers are out of scope entirely and recorded that they resolve to NotAnIdentityNumber -- and until spec 0.3.0 that was not true: the interim letters had been removed from the allowed set, so a reservnummer returned InvalidCharacter instead. Allowing Finland's alphabet made the recorded claim true, because every interim letter (T R S U W X J K L M N) is inside Finland's control-character set. This fixture is what keeps it true. Constructed, and invalid under every scheme: no bearer can exist because no registry issues this shape at all -- which is 1.3's entire point.
